plugins.name: yamm
plugins.description: Mail merge for Gmail and Google Sheets with YAMM (Yet Another Mail Merge): send a personalized email to each person on a list in a Google Sheet, from your own Gmail account, merged from a Gmail draft. Send yourself a test email first, then follow the sending and track opens, clicks, replies, bounces and unsubscribes.
